title: Erasable
description: A simple yet powerful mod that introduces a custom GUI, accessible with the "Y" key. It allows you to select and manage world areas using either manual or automatic coordinates, with the ability to delete and restore zones in just a few clicks.
body:
# 📖 Description 

## This mod adds a new functionality for handling world areas in Minecraft 🌖

### 🔹 Opening the GUI:
- Pressing the **"Y" key** opens a custom GUI.
- From here, you can choose how to set the two coordinates that define the area:
  1) **Manual input** → type in the coordinates directly;
  2) **Automatic input** → use the player’s current position as coordinates.

### 🔹 Main Features
- **Save area** → once both positions are set, the selected area is saved;
- **Quick deletion** → pressing the **"U" key** deletes the selected area from the world.
- **Restore last deleted area** → pressing **"I" key** restores the last removed area, useful in case of mistakes or second thoughts.

### 🔹 Practical Uses:
- Quickly clear land or unwanted structures.
- Prepare free space for new builds.
- Speed up testing for map-making or server management.

🚀 _Whether you’re a builder, a map-maker, or just a curious player, this mod gives you full control over your areas—fast, simple, and hassle-free_

PS: You can also find all my mod on Curseforge 🌖
